Title: LinkedIn Learning and Disprz Deep Integration Guide

Blocks.Text: The following steps outline the Disprz and LinkedIn Learning integration process:
Authentication: Single Sign-On (SSO)
Content Discovery: Automated Catalog Sync (All languages)
Reporting: xAPI
Requirements:
The LinkedIn Learning and Disprz integration involves the following requirements:

An active Disprz LMS instance

An active LinkedIn Learning account

Admin access to LinkedIn Learning

Admin privileges to your Disprz LMS instance

SSO authentication reduces friction for users and administrators by eliminating the
need for manual user registration. SSO ensures learners spend more of their time watching content and less of their time trying to remember usernames and passwords.

We recommend SAML SSO for all enterprise learning platform integrations. You can
configure SSO authentication in your LinkedIn Learning Admin settings. Most
organizations have a centrally-managed identity management solution like Azure
AD, Okta, or ADFS, which can be configured to authenticate users into enterprise
applications like LinkedIn Learning.
To configure SAML SSO with your identity management solution, share the LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide with your organization’s IT team.

The LinkedIn Learning library contains over 20,000 courses, with 20-30 courses
added per week at no extra cost. Disprz automates this process using the
LinkedIn Learning content APIs, so LMS admins do not have to manually upload new
content packages at regular intervals. After the initial setup, Disprz will
dynamically refresh the content library on an automated basis. This ensures
new LinkedIn Learning content is available to learners within 24 hours of
release. All content titles and  descriptions are aggregated and indexed to
accommodate keyword searches and support efficient discoverability. Disprz supports automatic syncing of All languages content libraries.

LinkedIn Learning captures all content viewed on its platform in robust usage
reports accessible from the LinkedIn Learning administrative interface. In
addition to generating reports, LinkedIn Learning uses xAPI to communicate a
learner’s activity back to Disprz when the learner completes a LinkedIn Learning course. All LinkedIn Learning course completions will be reported both in LinkedIn Learning and in Disprz.

Blocks.Section: Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync
SectionPath: Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text:
After you log in, if you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin, then click Me > Integrate.









From the side navigation menu, select Access content and reports via API and select Generate Linkedin Learning REST API Application.

Click Add application.





In the Add LinkedIn Learning API application screen, provide the name of your learning platform (e.g., "Disprz Content Sync"), as the application name.

Provide a short description of the integration use case in the application description field. For example - "Disprz Content Catalog Sync".

Under Choose keys, there are two checkboxes – Content and Report. Select both.  

Click Next and accept the "Terms and Conditions".





Copy the generated Client Id and Client Secret. Use these values later in the "Steps Performed in Disprz" section below.
To successfully complete the integration on the Disprz side; you'll need to input the following details; which must be retrieved from your LinkedIn Learning Admin portal:

Client ID

Client Secret

Account ID

SAML Configuration Name

ACS URL (Assertion Consumer Service URL)

Entity ID

Kindly share the required configuration information with the respective Disprz implementation point of contact (SPOC) to complete the setup process. The Disprz CSM portal for configuration is on the roadmap to be built for faster onboarding.
Note
Please note that it can take up to 24 hours for Disprz to index and make content available to learners.

Blocks.Section: Configuration steps to perform in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Configuration steps to perform in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: Using the configuration details obtained from Disprz, please follow the steps below to enable and complete the LinkedIn Learning setup:

Blocks.Section: Configuration steps to perform in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Configuration steps to perform in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text:
After you log in, if you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin, then click Me > Integrate.









From the side navigation menu, select Configure reporting integrations.





Expand the Configure xAPI section.

Click Add integration.





In the Integration name field, enter "Disprz".

In the User Type drop down, select Email.

Copy and paste the Auth URL, Tracking URL, Client ID and Client Secret provided by Disprz into LinkedIn Learning.

CLick on Course completions and Course progess only as disprz do not support Learning Path Completions and Video completions.

Click Enable.
